Internal helper: the jrecode() line that sends codes to free markers

Source: R/missing-internals.R
dot-jst_marker_recode_line.Rd

What runs, for a variable of Stata or SAS form, in place of a jdeclare_missing() line that would put its codes on markers the variable carries (.jst_marker_clash()): a recode of the codes to markers the variable does not use, each code's label carried, the else rule keeping every other value – the "keep them distinct" line of jdeclare_missing()'s own refusal. The codes take the letters in the order jdeclare_missing() gives them (largest magnitude first).

Usage

.jst_marker_recode_line(data_name, var_name, codes, conv, used, labels = NULL)

Arguments

data_name

The data frame as the line names it.

var_name

The variable.

codes

Numeric codes to send to markers.

conv

"stata" or "sas".

used

Tag letters already in use.

labels

Optional character vector parallel to codes: a label for each code's marker ("" for none).

Value

Character(1): one indented line, or NULL when too few letters are free.
